80: 			return;
81: 		}
82: 		
83: 		boolean suppressBaseMethods = annotation.getInstance().suppressBaseMethods();

85: 		List<Object> extensionProviders = annotation.getActualExpressions("value");
86: 		if (extensionProviders.isEmpty()) {
87: 			annotationNode.addError(String.format("@%s has no effect since no extension types were specified.", ExtensionMethod.class.getName()));
88: 			return;
89: 		}

105: 			Type providerType = CLASS.resolveMember(typeNode, provider.selected);

107: 			if ((providerType.tsym.flags() & (INTERFACE | ANNOTATION)) != 0) continue;

110: 		}
111: 		return extensions;
112: 	}

180: 			JCTree resolvedReceiver = resolution.get(receiver);
181: 			if (resolvedReceiver == null || resolvedReceiver.type == null) return;
182: 			Type receiverType = resolvedReceiver.type;
183: 			
184: 			// Skip static method access

188: 			} else if (resolvedReceiver instanceof JCFieldAccess) {
189: 				sym = ((JCFieldAccess) resolvedReceiver).sym;

199: 					Type extensionMethodType = extensionMethod.type;
200: 					if (!MethodType.class.isInstance(extensionMethodType) && !ForAll.class.isInstance(extensionMethodType)) continue;

Fixed and verified. Summary:

- **Root cause** (src/core/lombok/javac/handlers/HandleExtensionMethod.java:120): `(method.flags() & (STATIC | PUBLIC)) == 0` only skipped methods that were *neither* static *nor* public. - **Validation**: `ant test.javacCurrent` and `ant test.eclipse-202212` both pass fully, including the previously failing `ExtensionMethodNonStatic` resource test in all suites (delombok, javac, ecj); all other ExtensionMethod tests still pass, and the issue's reproduction example now compiles cleanly.
